title: Vanilla Features and Online Features (In Development)
news:
Online Features are coming soon with a different server.
You will be able to play with your friends online and have fun together.
The Vanilla Features are also coming soon,
which will allow you to experience the game in its original form with some changes.
Achivements are here, but in W.I.P. You will be able to unlock them by completing certain tasks in the game.

We are working hard to bring you the best experience possible, so stay tuned for more updates!
